Preprocessing spatial data
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)

# Define the folder containing the xlsx files
folder_path <- "~/Downloads/transfer_9300035_files_3f9769fb/Fichier_results_lung predict/"

# Get all xlsx file names in the folder
xlsx_files <- list.files(folder_path, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)

# Function to read sheet 2 from an xlsx file
read_sheet_2 <- function(file) {
  read_excel(file, sheet = 5) %>% 
    mutate(SourceFile = basename(file))  # Add file name as identifier
}

# Read all tables and combine them
combined_table <- map_dfr(xlsx_files, read_sheet_2)

# Format table
combined_table = combined_table %>%
  dplyr::select(-SourceFile) 

colnames(combined_table) = combined_table[1,]

combined_table = combined_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Slide ID` != "Slide ID") 
```

Processing of spatial data
```{r}
## Load clinical data
traitData = read.csv("../examples/Data/Gobbini/Raw_files/clinical_data_clean.csv")
## Extract patients with RNAseq
patients = traitData %>%
  filter(AN != "") %>%
  pull(AN)

data_spatial = list()
i = 1
for (x in unique(combined_table$`Tissue Category`)) {
  data_spatial[[i]] = combined_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(`Tissue Category` == x) %>% #Split by Tissue category (Stroma, Tumor, total)
    dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(.data$`Slide ID`, paste(patients, collapse = "|"))) %>% #Match with patients with RNAseq
    dplyr::mutate(PatientOrder = match(stringr::str_extract(.data$`Slide ID`, paste(patients, collapse = "|")), patients)) %>% #Extract the order of patients vector
    dplyr::arrange(PatientOrder) %>% #Match df with the corresponding order
    dplyr::select(-PatientOrder)# Remove temporary column
  
  names(data_spatial)[i] = x
    
  i = i + 1
}

# Subset to only patients with spatial data
patients = patients[which(patients%in%stringr::str_extract(data_spatial[[1]]$`Slide ID`, paste(patients, collapse = "|")))]

for (i in 1:length(data_spatial)) {
  data_spatial[[i]] = data_spatial[[i]] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Samples = paste0("Patient_", stringr::str_extract(data_spatial[[i]]$`Slide ID`, paste(patients, collapse = "|"))),
                  Features = paste0(.data$From, "_", .data$To)) %>%
    dplyr::select(-`Slide ID`, -`Tissue Category`, -From, -To) 
    #na.omit() 
}
```

Load CellTFusion features
```{r}
load("Results_features_Gobbini.RData")
deconv = read.csv("Results/Deconvolution_LP_Gobbini_spatial.csv", row.names = 1)
```

Gather features by sample and tissue
```{r}
features = list()
for (tissue in 1:length(data_spatial)) {
  x_list <- list()
  for (i in 1:nrow(cell_groups[[1]])) {
    x = data_spatial[[tissue]] %>%
      dplyr::filter(Samples == rownames(cell_groups[[1]])[i]) %>%
      tibble::column_to_rownames("Features") %>%
      dplyr::select(-Min, -Max, -Median, -SD) #Take Mean value

    colnames(x)[1] = x$Samples[1]
    x$Samples = NULL
    x_list[[i]] = x
  }
  features[[tissue]] = do.call(cbind, x_list)
  names(features)[tissue] = names(data_spatial)[tissue]
}

all.equal(rownames(cell_groups[[1]]), colnames(features[[1]])) ## Verify there are the same patients before doing correlation
```

Metadata correlation
```{r}
source("src/environment_set.R") #Load functions and packages

names_distances = rownames(features[[1]])
distances = apply(features[[1]], 2, as.numeric)
rownames(distances) = names_distances
```

Correlation of features
```{r}
for (i in 1:length(features)) {
  compute.modules.relationship(t(features[[i]]), cell_groups[[1]], paste0("Correlation_cell_groups_spatial_", names(features)[i]), vertical = T, height = 15, width = 30, pval = 0.05, par_mar = c(10, 30, 5, 1))
}
```

Cell group composition
```{r}
## Reorder cell groups based on 
cell.composition = compute.composition.matrix(deconv, dt, cell_groups, cells_extra = c("tpDC", "tDC1", "tDC2", "tDC3"))

#Cell groups
colors <- structure(c("white", "blue"), names = c("0", "1")) 

ht2 = Heatmap(cell.composition, 
        border = T, show_row_dend = F, name = "Cell presence",
        column_gap = unit(8, "mm"), col = colors, row_names_side = "left",
        column_dend_height = unit(5, "cm"), row_dend_width = unit(5, "cm"), 
        cluster_rows = F,
        column_dend_reorder = F, row_dend_reorder = F,
        show_row_names = T, show_column_names = T,
        show_heatmap_legend = T, 
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16), 
        column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize =12), 
        width = unit(20, "cm"), height = unit(25, "cm"),
        heatmap_legend_param = list(labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20), legend_width = unit(15, "cm"), 
                                    title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 20)))

pdf("Results/Cell_groups_composition", width = 20, height = 15)
draw(ht2, show_heatmap_legend = T, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom", annotation_legend_side = 'bottom')
dev.off()
```
